content.title: 3 Consumer Stocks We Steer Clear Of
content.summary: Consumer staples are considered safe havens in turbulent markets due to their inelastic demand profiles. Over the past six months, the industry has recorded a loss of 13.5%, a far cry from the S&P 500’s 10.1% ascent.
